noAccess.title: You cannot open this tab
noAccess.body: Applications and plans need Global › See records. Ask an admin for the right.

apps.connectOwner: Only the owner can connect an application.

notes.latency: Response and errors show «—» until Sentral logs its calls to each application.
notes.maintenance: Maintenance mode needs an application command that does not exist yet.
notes.test: Test connection reaches Orgpuls only; the other applications have no command path from Sentral yet.

flags.title: Feature flags · {name}
flags.noCommand: {name} has no feature flag command yet, so its flags cannot be read from here.
flags.noSetCommand: {name} has no command to switch them.
flags.unreachable: {name} did not answer ({code}). Its feature flags are not shown.
flags.readOnly: Switching a flag needs the right to configure.
flags.pilots: {count, plural, one {pilot in # account} other {pilot in # accounts}}

dialog.publishBody: Every account can use it once it is published. It can be retired later, but not taken back to draft.
dialog.retireBody: Accounts can no longer choose it. A retired version cannot be published again.
dialog.reason: Reason (kept in Orgpuls' audit, at least five characters)
dialog.failed: Orgpuls refused or did not answer ({code}).

key.title: API key
key.body: Applications use this key to send accounts, usage and billing events to Sentral.
key.rotation: The secrets stay in Sentral's vault and are never shown. To replace them, the owner opens a one-time intake number (15 minutes) and the application posts its new secrets with it.

notice.title: Status message
notice.placeholder: Shown at the top of the app for all users
notice.saved: Saved in Sentral — not delivered to {name} ({code})
notice.clearedSaved: Cleared in Sentral — not delivered to {name} ({code})
notice.problem: Linked to problem T-{number}: it clears when the problem is resolved.
notice.noCommand: {name} has no status message command yet.
notice.readOnly: Publishing needs the right to configure.
notice.readFailed: The current status message could not be read.

plans.none: There are no plans for {name} in the plan catalogue.
plans.monthsFree: {count, plural, one {# month free} other {# months free}}
plans.readOnly: Prices, trial length and the annual discount are set in Orgpuls, which runs checkout. Sentral reads the plan catalogue (the trial length is not reported to it) and has no command to change them yet.

team.title: Team
team.invited: Invited {email} · no email is sent: they sign in with this address once an owner has created their login
team.readOnly: You can see the team. Changing roles, inviting and removing need the security right.
team.selfNote: You cannot change your own role or remove yourself.
team.legend: Admin: everything · Sales: CRM · Support: Customers and tickets · Marketing: Growth · Read-only: view only
team.invitedMail: {email} is invited: an email with a sign-up link is on its way.

email.title: Email (Brevo)
email.intro: Connect Brevo so Sentral can send ticket replies, invitations, security alerts and campaigns.
email.keyLabel: Brevo API key (Brevo › SMTP & API › API keys)
email.keyNote: The key goes straight to Sentral's vault and is never shown again. Sentral checks it with Brevo and registers its delivery events.
email.connected: Brevo is connected: {verified} of {domains} sending addresses verified.
email.disconnected: Brevo is disconnected; nothing is sent.
email.publicBase: Public address for links in emails
email.publicBaseNote: Unsubscribe and invitation links open here: Sentral's own address.
email.inboundNote: With a domain whose MX record points to Brevo's inbound parsing, customers answer support@ that domain and their answer lands on the ticket.
email.inboundOk: Answers to support@{domain} land on the ticket.
email.inboundPending: Waiting: point the MX record of {domain} to Brevo, then check again.
email.ownerOnly: Only the owner connects and manages the mail provider.
email.sendersNote: Each application sends its customers' mail from its own address: Orgpuls tickets from Orgpuls. Authenticate the domain in Brevo (Senders, domains & dedicated IPs), then check again.
email.senderSaved: Address added; Brevo was asked about its domain.

codes.unreachable: Sentral could not reach the mail function ({code}).
codes.expired: The form was open too long. Try again.

email.noSenderApp: Brevo is connected, but {app} has no verified sending address yet: its ticket replies are stored, not emailed. Add one below.
